correction_reason: The saved run card reports HOLDOUT-DTI, confidence interval, and withheld-positive count as null; no holdout result exists.
The run card itself says the feature-alone leakage canary cannot run without authenticated competition data.
The included generator uses a synthetic fault-mask placeholder and an all-true placeholder footprint when competition data are absent.
The source places/selects the final dots before its registry check, so it did not satisfy the required pre-placement surface gate.
The run card's uniqueness comparison covers only two local rasters, not a complete immutable registry.

A later pinned-byte surface audit found a DUPLICATE_STOP against the 13GEMSDOE lattice witness: 4,684 of 4,685 support dots (0.9997866) lie within 3 px. The witness manifest explicitly says it is incomplete, so this strengthens the negative decision but does not claim a full-registry comparison.
No assigned method paragraph authorizes this method; format validation and two-reference comparison cannot authorize promotion.
disposition: Moved from docs/downloads to evidence/quarantine. The original raster and sidecars are retained unchanged for audit history; no new raster was generated and no experiment or slot was used by this review.
